summary: CalTrans appears in this window in two distinct roles: as a participant in the Preferential Treatment Program under the TSM element, and as the provider of highway system information and road network speed data used by the LARTS branch to develop patronage forecasts for the eleven alternatives. CalTrans does not express support for or opposition to any alternative, functioning purely as a data and program contributor.
